== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Parryl Cryce{{!}}Parryl is a [[Lichborn]] girl known as the Green Knight. Recognized for her genuine abilities and chosen at an early age due to her relation to [[Doctor Cryce]], she is the youngest member of a group that includes the [[White Knight]]. She is characterized by her emerald-glowing eyes and an energetic, cheerful manner of speaking. Her role involves serving as a support pilot for a starship while her [[Divine Titan]] is being repaired. The Green [[Divine Titan]] itself is a pristine machine featuring emerald-colored eyes and an extensive array of weaponry. Although she has previously faced extreme danger, such as being attacked by [[giant worms]], Parryl Cryce{{!}}Parryl eventually transitioned from her role as the Green Knight when she was replaced by a [[Visiri]] named [[Trisk]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Green Knight was a formidable opponent once engaged in combat by Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion. During the period when her [[Divine Titan]] fell from [[Subspace]], she served as a [[Titan Knight]] piloting a starship in a support capacity while her primary machine underwent repairs. Her eventual death became a massive galactic event, marking the loss of an individual who possessed the potential to pose a direct threat to Eshkinaar. Following these events, Parryl Cryce{{!}}Parryl assumed the mantle of the former Green Knight.}}
